One important correction: Call.com Telecom Limited is not a managed business-travel provider. Its current product is a virtual phone/calling and messaging service for individuals, freelancers and small businesses, so it isn't a meaningful travel-management alternative. 
call.com
+1

Provider	Current price	Key exclusions / limitations	Best for
Call.com Telecom Limited	Freemium; paid SIP/number/SMS usage	No corporate travel booking, expense, hotel or travel-policy management	Not suitable for this use case
MakeMyTrip myBiz	No published platform fee; booking-based pricing	Mainly self-service; complex managed-service requirements may need a separate arrangement	50-person India-first company wanting easy employee booking + GST/expense tools 
MakeMyTrip Biz

Thomas Cook India Corporate Travel	Quote-based	No public standard fee; service scope/pricing negotiated	Companies wanting human support, air/hotel/rail/visa/forex and 24×7 servicing 
Thomas Cook

FCM Travel India	Quote-based	Contract pricing; exact service fees require proposal	Companies with more complex domestic + international travel programmes

Purchase takeaway: For 50 employees, get quotes from myBiz and Thomas Cook first. myBiz is more self-serve; Thomas Cook is substantially more of a managed TMC. Neither publishes a simple per-employee monthly price, so compare transaction fees, mark-ups, cancellation handling and after-hours support in the quotes.
